summary.text: Gordon Ramey II is the Republican candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 27, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was nominated to replace Tyler Bowen, who won the Republican primary but was removed from the general election ballot after moving out of West Virginia.

paragraphs.text: Ramey earned a bachelor's degree from Marshall University and is a retired major in the West Virginia Army National Guard.

His career experience includes working as a lieutenant and supervisor for the police service at the Huntington VA Medical Center, serving as Huntington's chief of police, and teaching military science as an assistant professor at West Virginia University, West Virginia State University, the University of Charleston and Eastern Illinois University.
Ramey was an at-large member of the Cabell County Board of Education, assuming office in 2016.
